|translation='''Title:''' URoRRuR'R'R's Hunting Rifle.

'''Card text:'''
Spend 1 Force to deploy on URoRRuR'R'R or Chief Bast. Or spend 3 Force to deploy on a non-droid character (even a non-warrior). Spend 1 Force to activate it. Draw destiny. A character is hit if destiny minus 1 is greater than ability. A creature is immediately lost if destiny plus 2 is greater than defense value.

'''Lore:'''
In Tusken society, owning a hunting rifle marks high status. URoRRuR'R'R recovered this weapon from a starship that crashed near Anchorhead.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face uses 起動する (activate) where the English original says may target using 1 Force.
